description: Change a tracking link between active and disabled, and/or attach the ad network's own campaign id to a link created without one (then pull_network_spend can match its spend). Send status, network_campaign_id, or both. A campaign that already has a different network id is refused with 409 network_campaign_conflict.

idempotency_key.description: Stable retry key for this exact mutation.

link_id.description: The link's id (UUID), as returned by list_links or create_campaign_link.

network_campaign_id.description: The ad network's own campaign id (for Meta, the campaign ID in Ads Manager).

status.description: active: the link sends people to your store page. disabled: it stops. Omit to leave the status as it is.

name: update_link_status
title: Enable or disable a campaign link, or attach its network campaign id
